title:
一、(一) 英譯中：請將下列英文句子譯成中文。（10 分）
Each inbound passenger must declare the amount of foreign currencies in excess of US$10,000 or its equivalent in other foreign currencies. If not declared, the exceeding amount of foreign currencies shall, upon arrival, be subject to confiscation.
answer: 每位入境旅客攜帶超過美金一萬元或等值其他外幣者，必須申報。未申報者，超過部分的外幣於入境時將被沒收。
hint:
句構拆解
  • Each inbound passenger must declare the amount of foreign currencies：主幹（每位入境旅客必須申報外幣金額）。
  • in excess of US$10,000 or its equivalent in other foreign currencies：in excess of＝超過；or its equivalent in＝或等值於。
  • If not declared,：分詞構句的省略（If it is not declared）。
  • the exceeding amount of foreign currencies shall, upon arrival, be subject to confiscation：shall be subject to＝將被處以、將遭受；upon arrival＝於入境時。
關鍵詞
  • inbound passenger 入境旅客
  • declare 申報
  • in excess of 超過
  • equivalent 等值物
  • confiscation 沒收
翻譯技巧
  • 英文把「金額」放在 declare 之後、條件放在後面；中文習慣先講條件：「攜帶超過……者，必須申報」。
  • 「be subject to confiscation」直譯「受沒收處分」較生硬，譯「將被沒收」即可。
  • 這是海關規定，語氣要正式。
易錯點
  • 把 exceeding amount 譯成「超額的金額」可以，但不要漏掉「超過部分」。
  • equivalent 不要譯成「相等」，這裡是「等值」。

title:
一、(二) 中譯英：請將下列中文句子譯成英文。（15 分）
機場已加強保安措施。為免延誤，旅客須確保手提行李內沒有任何違禁物品，亦沒有隨身攜帶這類物品。
answer: Security measures have been strengthened at the airport. To avoid delays, passengers must make sure that there are no prohibited items in their carry-on luggage, nor are any such items carried on their person.
hint:
句構策略
  • 「機場已加強保安措施」→ 被動語態 Security measures have been strengthened at the airport.
  • 「為免延誤」→ To avoid delays（不定詞表目的）。
  • 「旅客須確保……」→ passengers must make sure that...。
  • 「手提行李內沒有任何違禁物品，亦沒有隨身攜帶這類物品」→ 用 there are no prohibited items in their carry-on luggage, nor are any such items carried on their person（nor 後倒裝）。
關鍵詞
  • 保安措施 security measures
  • 加強 strengthen／tighten
  • 違禁物品 prohibited items／contraband
  • 手提行李 carry-on luggage／hand luggage
  • 隨身攜帶 carry on one's person
加分寫法
  • 「亦沒有」也可用 and that none are carried on their person，避免倒裝。
  • 「違禁物品」也可用 banned items。
易錯點
  • 「加強保安措施」不要逐字譯 strengthen the security measures at the airport——用被動式更像公告語氣。
  • 「隨身攜帶」不是 take with body，用 carry on one's person。

title:
二、英文作文：（25 分）
Write an English essay of approximately 250 words on the qualifications of a good customs inspector.
answer:
A customs inspector stands at the point where a country meets the world, and the qualifications required of him or her reflect that position. In my view, three matter most: integrity, professional knowledge, and the ability to communicate with people under pressure.

Integrity comes first because the job is defined by discretion. An inspector decides whether a container is examined or released, whether a declaration is accepted or questioned, and whether a small discrepancy is a mistake or a smuggling attempt. Every one of those decisions carries financial value for someone. Without integrity, knowledge and efficiency merely make corruption more sophisticated.

Professional knowledge is the second qualification. Tariff classification, rules of origin, prohibited goods, and risk indicators are technical subjects, and an inspector who cannot read a manifest or recognize a forged certificate is useless at the counter. Knowledge also protects the officer: a clear legal basis is the best defense against pressure from importers or complaints from travelers.

Finally, communication matters more than outsiders expect. Most travelers are not smugglers; they are tired, confused, or frightened. An inspector who explains procedures calmly and treats people with courtesy obtains better information and creates fewer disputes than one who shouts. In a busy airport, patience is a professional skill, not a personality trait.

Integrity, expertise, and courtesy: these are the qualifications I would look for in a customs inspector, and the ones I would try hardest to develop in myself.
hint:
審題
  • 題目要求「一位好海關稽查員的資格」，約 250 字；需選定幾項核心資格並說明理由。
  • 建議三項：integrity（廉潔）、professional knowledge（專業知識）、communication under pressure（溝通能力）。
  • 每一項都要連結海關的實際工作情境（查驗、估價、申報、旅客溝通）。
五段架構
  • 第一段（引言）：海關是國家與世界的交會點，點出三項資格。
  • 第二段（廉潔）：裁量權大、每個決定都有金錢價值；沒有廉潔，專業只會讓貪腐更精密。
  • 第三段（專業）：稅則分類、原產地規則、違禁品、風險指標；清楚的法律依據是最好的防禦。
  • 第四段（溝通）：多數旅客不是走私犯，而是疲累、困惑、害怕的人；耐心是專業技能。
  • 第五段（結論）：三項資格並列，並回扣「我會如何要求自己」。
關鍵詞彙
  • customs inspector 海關稽查員；discretion 裁量權
  • tariff classification 稅則分類；rules of origin 原產地規則
  • manifest 艙單；forged certificate 偽造證書
  • prohibited goods 違禁品；risk indicators 風險指標
  • integrity 廉潔；courtesy 禮貌
加分句型
  • A customs inspector stands at the point where a country meets the world.（開場比喻）
  • Without integrity, knowledge and efficiency merely make corruption more sophisticated.（反面論證）
  • Most travelers are not smugglers; they are tired, confused, or frightened.（排比）
  • Patience is a professional skill, not a personality trait.（對比收尾）
評分重點
  • 至少三項資格，每項都要有具體工作情境。
  • 避免空泛的「認真負責」；用 integrity、discretion 等精確詞。
  • 約 250 字，結構完整。

title: A piece of food ______ his airway and caused him to stop breathing. He was immediately rushed to the hospital.
hint:
1. A piece of food obstructed his airway and caused him to stop breathing. He was immediately rushed to the hospital.
（一塊食物堵住他的氣道，使他停止呼吸。他被緊急送醫。）
  • 考點：obstruct＝阻擋、堵塞（obstruct the airway＝堵塞氣道）。
  • 線索：stop breathing（停止呼吸）＋rushed to the hospital（緊急送醫）→ 氣道被堵住。
  • 其他選項：exhilarate 使興奮；retrieve 取回；intimidate 威脅。
撇步
  • 氣道、通道、視線被擋住 → obstruct（名詞 obstruction）。

title: It is often said that ______ is better than cure, so why not take some precautions in advance?
hint:
2. It is often said that prevention is better than cure, so why not take some precautions in advance?
（常言道預防勝於治療，那何不事先採取一些預防措施？）
  • 考點：Prevention is better than cure.＝預防勝於治療（英文諺語）。
  • 線索：take some precautions（採取預防措施）→ 對應 prevention。
  • 其他選項：process 過程；priority 優先；prosperity 繁榮。
撇步
  • 諺語題直接記：prevention is better than cure。

title: After six years' outstanding military service, Jason received an honorable ______.
hint:
3. After six years' outstanding military service, Jason received an honorable discharge.
（服役六年表現傑出後，傑森光榮退伍。）
  • 考點：honorable discharge＝光榮退伍（軍事用語）。
  • 線索：military service（服役）＋outstanding（傑出）→ 退伍。
  • 其他選項：deduction 扣除；detachment 分遣隊、超然；disgrace 恥辱（反義）。
撇步
  • 軍人退伍＝discharge；honorable discharge 是光榮退伍。

title: Experts of education are concerned about the negative influence on children and adolescents from the daily ______ of vulgar language, sex, and violence on TV shows.
hint:
4. Experts of education are concerned about the negative influence on children and adolescents from the daily barrage of vulgar language, sex, and violence on TV shows.
（教育專家擔心電視節目每天排山倒海的粗話、性與暴力，對兒童與青少年造成負面影響。）
  • 考點：a barrage of＝排山倒海的一連串（原意為彈幕）。
  • 線索：daily（每天）＋vulgar language, sex, and violence（粗話、性、暴力）→ 大量而持續的衝擊。
  • 其他選項：contempt 輕蔑；petition 請願；remedy 補救。
撇步
  • 「一連串、排山倒海的」→ a barrage of（近義：a flood of、a stream of）。

title: Although this tastes fine, I don't think it's a good ______ for real butter.
hint:
5. Although this tastes fine, I don't think it's a good substitute for real butter.
（雖然這個味道還不錯，但我不覺得它是真奶油的好替代品。）
  • 考點：a substitute for＝……的替代品。
  • 線索：tastes fine（味道不錯）＋real butter（真奶油）→ 替代品。
  • 其他選項：reception 接待；compartment 隔間；patron 贊助者、顧客。
撇步
  • a substitute for A＝A 的替代品；動詞 substitute A for B。

title:
To best ensure successful completion of large-scale research projects and the appropriate adoption of technologies that arise from their projects, investigators working in global health must pay attention not only to science, but to the ethical, social, and cultural issues that surround their work. These ethical, social, and cultural concerns have become increasingly important to the success of projects    6    in the developing world, including many of the projects funded by Grand Challenges in Global Health.    7    Grand Challenges in Global Health investigators, Drs. Singer and Lavery and their colleagues are providing advisory services on ethical, social, and cultural issues related to research in the developing world. In addition, their project aims to help foster the successful and appropriate adoption by communities    8    technologies that result from Grand Challenges in Global Health projects.

The project team's advisory service for Grand Challenges investigators is in place, and work has begun to plan for the successful adoption of technologies that may    9    from Grand Challenges in Global Health projects. The project team is currently conducting two global case studies, one on community engagement in research in the developing world and    10    on commercialization of health products in low-resource settings. The case studies will identify good practices in both areas.

subItems.hint:
6. ...the success of projects undertaken in the developing world...
（……在開發中國家所進行的計畫能否成功……）
  • 考點：undertake＝著手進行、承辦（過去分詞 undertaken 修飾 projects）。
  • 線索：projects ___ in the developing world（在開發中國家被……的計畫）→ 被執行。
  • 其他選項：unqualified 不合格的；underestimated 被低估的；unemployed 失業的。
撇步
  • 計畫「被執行」→ projects undertaken。

7. To assist Grand Challenges in Global Health investigators, Drs. Singer and Lavery and their colleagues are providing advisory services...
（為了協助 Grand Challenges 的研究者，Singer 與 Lavery 博士及其同事正在提供顧問服務……）
  • 考點：To assist（不定詞置句首表目的）＝為了協助。
  • 句構：To assist..., 主詞＋are providing... → 目的與主要動作。
  • 其他選項：Assist（原形，句首缺少 to 或主詞）；Assisted／Being assisted（被動，語意相反）。
撇步
  • 句首「為了……」→ To + V。

8. ...to help foster the successful and appropriate adoption by communities in need of technologies that result from Grand Challenges in Global Health projects.
（……協助需要這些技術的社區成功且適當地採用 Grand Challenges 計畫所產出的技術。）
  • 考點：in need of＝需要（communities in need of technologies＝需要技術的社區）。
  • 其他選項：instead of 而非；in lieu of 代替；in and out of 進出。
撇步
  • 需要某物 → in need of（後接名詞）。

9. ...the successful adoption of technologies that may arise from Grand Challenges in Global Health projects.
（……可能源自這些計畫的技術能否被成功採用。）
  • 考點：arise from＝源自、產生（不及物）。
  • 辨析：arise（不及物，源自）vs raise（及物，舉起／提高）vs arouse（及物，引起）。
  • 其他選項：arouse／raise／have raised 都需要受詞，此處 technologies 是主詞。
撇步
  • 問題、機會、技術「源自」→ arise from。

10. ...two global case studies, one on community engagement in research in the developing world and the other on commercialization of health products in low-resource settings.
（……兩項全球個案研究，一項關於開發中國家的社區參與，另一項關於低資源環境下健康產品的商業化。）
  • 考點：one... the other...＝（兩者中）一個……另一個……。
  • 線索：two global case studies（兩項研究）→ 兩者中的另一個。
  • 其他選項：another（三者以上中的另一個）；one（會變成 one... one...）；the others（其餘全部）。
撇步
  • 只有兩個時用 one... the other；三個以上才用 another。

title: The struggle to save the food supply from damage did not end with Silent Spring.    11    For example, in order to increase the protein in cattle, people began to alter the diet of cows. Cows do not eat meat in their natural surroundings, but farm industries in many countries began feeding cows the ground-up parts of dead sheep.    12    According to them, this harmful process, begun by humans for greater profits, led to outbreaks of “mad cow disease” in the United States. This was a misfortune for the beef industry. Farmers also often feed large amounts of antibiotics and hormones to their animals to make them stronger.    13    This is harmful to us all because human diseases are becoming less responsive to antibiotics, and the hormones are not good for children. Recently, food manufacturers in the United States have developed a new method of irradiating food to kill bacteria.    14    The dangers to the food supply depicted by the environmental movement have led many people to buy only natural products from organic farms, which do not use chemical pesticides.    15    People in many countries are puzzled about how to carry on the legacy of being responsible for the environment, which is the message of Silent Spring.

options.text: Many scientists believe that some cows' nervous systems were stricken by a sheep disease called scrapie.
The need to maintain a prosperous agricultural economy has led to many difficulties.
Many people want to ban irradiated food because they are not sure such food is safe.
But organic foods are expensive and hard to find.

subItems.hint:
11. → The need to maintain a prosperous agricultural economy has led to many difficulties.
（維持農業經濟繁榮的需求，導致了許多問題。）
  • 定位：空格後接「For example, in order to increase the protein in cattle...」（例如，為了增加牛的蛋白質……）→ 空格應是概括性的主題句，說明「為了經濟利益而衍生問題」。
  • 選項契合：「維持農業經濟繁榮的需求」正好統攝後面「餵牛吃羊、抗生素、激素」等例子。
  • 其他選項：scrapie（羊搔癢症，屬 12 的細節）、irradiated food（屬 14）、organic foods（屬 15）。
撇步
  • 空格後有 For example → 空格是總說。

options.text: Many scientists believe that some cows' nervous systems were stricken by a sheep disease called scrapie.
These large doses accumulate in animal organs and are eaten by humans.
Many people want to ban irradiated food because they are not sure such food is safe.
The need to maintain a prosperous agricultural economy has led to many difficulties.

subItems.hint:
12. → Many scientists believe that some cows' nervous systems were stricken by a sheep disease called scrapie.
（許多科學家認為，有些牛的神经系统是被一種叫羊搔癢症的羊病所侵害。）
  • 定位：前句說農場把死羊磨碎餵牛；後句「According to them, this harmful process... led to outbreaks of 'mad cow disease'」——them 指科學家。
  • 選項契合：先提「科學家認為……」，後面才能用 According to them 承接。
  • 其他選項：large doses（屬 13）、irradiated food（屬 14）、agricultural economy（已用於 11）。
撇步
  • 代名詞線索：According to them → 前一句必須出現「them＝科學家」。

options.text: The animals enjoy taking antibiotics and hormones so much.
Several scientists believe that some cows' nervous systems were stricken by a sheep disease called scrapie.
These large doses accumulate in animal organs and are eaten by humans.
They are indispensable for organic foods.

subItems.hint:
13. → These large doses accumulate in animal organs and are eaten by humans.
（這些大劑量會累積在動物器官中，被人類吃下。）
  • 定位：前句「Farmers also often feed large amounts of antibiotics and hormones...」；後句「This is harmful to us all because human diseases are becoming less responsive to antibiotics...」→ 空格應說明為何對人有害。
  • 選項契合：These large doses 呼應前句的 large amounts；accumulate... eaten by humans 說明危害途徑。
  • 其他選項：動物喜歡吃藥（荒謬）、scrapie（已用於 12）、organic foods（屬 15）。
撇步
  • 代名詞 These large doses 一定緊接「large amounts of...」。

options.text: Many people think that food manufacturers in the United States are smart enough to develop a new method of killing bacteria.
The need to maintain a prosperous agricultural economy has led to many difficulties.
But organic foods are expensive and hard to find.
Many people want to ban irradiated food because they are not sure such food is safe.

subItems.hint:
14. → Many people want to ban irradiated food because they are not sure such food is safe.
（許多人想禁止輻照食品，因為他們不確定這種食品是否安全。）
  • 定位：前句「food manufacturers... have developed a new method of irradiating food to kill bacteria」；後句「The dangers... have led many people to buy only natural products...」→ 空格應說明大眾對輻照食品的反應。
  • 其他選項：(A) 是正面肯定（與後文「dangers」的擔憂語氣不合）；(B) 已用於 11；(C) 屬 15。
撇步
  • 空格後接「The dangers...」→ 空格應是「大眾擔心安全」的負面反應。

options.text: The government forced people to buy only natural products.
Luckily, all people agree to buy natural food.
But organic foods are expensive and hard to find.
In fact, irradiating food is not so harmful.

subItems.hint:
15. → But organic foods are expensive and hard to find.
（但有機食品昂貴又不易買到。）
  • 定位：前句「many people to buy only natural products from organic farms...」；後句「People in many countries are puzzled about how to carry on the legacy...」→ 空格應說明「為何困惑」：有機食品貴又難找。
  • 其他選項：(A) 政府強迫（文中無）；(B) 所有人都同意（太絕對）；(D) 輻照無害（與前後文矛盾）。
撇步
  • 後句 puzzled 是線索：前面要先有一個「兩難」（有機好但貴）。

title:
Sit down in an airport main concourse today and you'll catch a glimpse of what makes the modern world tick. On a personal level, families reunite and adventures begin amid the swirl of our rapidly globalizing world. As for technology, one witnesses a marvel here as we conquer the skies.

Denver International Airport (DIA), one of the largest (it covers 54 square miles) and fifth busiest airport in USA (in 2013, 25.5 million people passed under its unique tented roof), was the first U.S. airport to develop a comprehensive plan to manage environmental impact and the first to meet national and international sustainability standards.

DIA marked another first when it earned membership in the Environmental Protection Agency's Performance Track for excelling in protecting human health and the environment. Meanwhile, the Colorado Department of Public Health has recognized DIA for 10 years running as a Colorado Environmental Gold Leader for voluntarily going beyond compliance with state and federal regulations and for its continual environmental improvement.

Throughout these efforts and accolades, natural gas vehicles have been a key component of sustainability efforts at the airport. Using compressed natural gas (CNG) in DIA's 221 natural gas vehicles saves more than $135,000 each year in fuel costs. Based on the savings and overall success, the airport plans to add 25 to 50 more natural gas vehicles soon.

“We continue to invest in initiatives that reduce our carbon footprint and are financially viable, which assures their perpetuity even in times of economic downturn,” said airport CEO Kim Day. “Natural gas is a key part of our energy portfolio, as it provides a lower-cost and more environmentally friendly solution for many of our operations.”

Airport leaders recognize that DIA is not alone in a growing reliance on natural gas—other members of this little city, passengers, also may rely on the clean energy to power their vehicles. DIA provides public access for compressed natural gas fueling at rental car fueling stations.

One gallon equivalent of natural gas is a little less than one-half the cost of one gallon of diesel fuel, so the cost savings are significant. CNG burns much cleaner than other fuels. CNG vehicles are better for the environment. Users' experience with CNG buses has been positive and they would certainly consider using more of CNG technology for future vehicles at the airport.

subItems.title: 16. What does the “marvel” in Paragraph 1 refer to?

options.text: The use of natural gas vehicles.

subItems.hint:
→ A new airport concourse.
（第一段的 marvel 指什麼？→ 一座新的機場航廈。）
  • 定位：第一段「Sit down in an airport main concourse today... As for technology, one witnesses a marvel here as we conquer the skies.」
  • 推論：marvel 指眼前這座讓「征服天空」成真的機場建築（航廈），不是家庭團聚或旅客冒險。
  • 其他選項：家庭團聚與旅客冒險屬「personal level」；天然氣車輛在後段才出現。
  • ⚠️ 此題選項與原文措辭對應較鬆散，我選 (C)，請對照你的答案。
撇步
  • 指示詞 marvel 要看前一句的主題（airport concourse）。

subItems.title: 17. Which of the following is true about DIA?

options.text: It's the fifth largest airport in the U.S.
It's criticized for its poor environmental management.
It provides CNG fueling at car rental stations.
It has met national, but not international, sustainability standards.

subItems.hint:
→ It provides CNG fueling at car rental stations.
（DIA 在租車加油站提供壓縮天然氣加氣服務。）
  • 定位：第六段「DIA provides public access for compressed natural gas fueling at rental car fueling stations.」
  • 其他選項：(A) 文中是「第五繁忙」機場，不是第五大；(B) 文中是獲獎，不是被批評；(D) 文中說同時符合國內與國際永續標準。
撇步
  • 細節題注意「busiest（最繁忙）vs largest（最大）」的偷換。

subItems.title: 18. What is Paragraph 3 mainly about?

options.text: The major features in the construction of DIA.
The roles of DIA and Colorado Department of Public Health.

subItems.hint:
→ DIA's excellence in environmental protection.
（第三段主要談什麼？→ DIA 在環保方面的卓越表現。）
  • 定位：第三段「DIA marked another first when it earned membership in the EPA's Performance Track for excelling in protecting human health and the environment... recognized... for 10 years running as a Colorado Environmental Gold Leader...」
  • 其他選項：發展歷史（第二段）、建築特色（第二段的帳篷屋頂）、DIA 與衛生局的角色（只是被提及）。
撇步
  • 段落主旨看重複的關鍵詞：excelling、Gold Leader、environmental improvement。

subItems.title: 19. Which of the following is NOT true about CNG vehicles in DIA?

options.text: More purchase of such vehicles will be made.
There are more than 200 natural gas vehicles in DIA.
Each vehicle saves DIA $135,000 a year in fuel cost.
They release less carbon than vehicles powered by diesel fuel.

subItems.hint:
→ Each vehicle saves DIA $135,000 a year in fuel cost.
（下列何者不為真？→ 每輛車每年為 DIA 省下 13.5 萬美元。）
  • 定位：第四段「Using CNG in DIA's 221 natural gas vehicles saves more than $135,000 each year in fuel costs.」——13.5 萬是全部 221 輛的總節省，不是每輛。
  • 其他選項：(A) 計畫再添 25–50 輛 ✓；(B) 221 輛＞200 ✓；(D) CNG 燃燒更乾淨、碳排更少 ✓。
撇步
  • 數字題注意「總額 vs 每輛」的偷換。

subItems.title: 20. Which of the following words means “endless duration or existence”?
subItems.hint:
→ perpetuity.
（哪個字意為「無止境的持續或存在」？→ perpetuity。）
  • 定位：第五段「...which assures their perpetuity even in times of economic downturn」。
  • 字義：perpetuity＝永久、永續（in perpetuity＝永遠）。
  • 其他選項：compliance 遵守；initiatives 倡議；accolades 讚譽。
撇步
  • 字義題拆字根：per-（貫穿）+ pet-（追求）→ 永遠。

title: In the cooking show “MasterChef,” the audience remember the big smile that lit up Christine Ha's face every time she impressed the judges with her bold flavors—and especially when her three-course meal of Vietnamese comfort food won the “MasterChef” title. What casual viewers may not have realized right away is that the amateur cook from Houston, Texas, is blind. In 2003, Ha was diagnosed with a rare neurological condition that deteriorates the optic nerves and spinal cord. By 2007, Ha had lost most of her vision. But she had regained her love of reading, with help from the National Library Service for the Blind and Physically Handicapped (NLS). “NLS reignited my love for literature. It was what kept me sane when I went through the challenging treatment,” says Ha. “When I went through some of my worst health issues—complete paralysis from my neck down due to spinal inflammation, and complete blindness—all I could do was lie in bed and listen to NLS audio books.” NLS, part of the Library of Congress, oversees a free reading program for U.S. residents and citizens living abroad who are blind, have low vision, or cannot hold a book because of a physical disability. NLS patrons may choose from tens of thousands of books and dozens of magazines in audio and braille—including dozens of cookbooks. NLS also loans the portable playback equipment needed to read its audio books. Computer-savvy patrons may access books online through the NLS Braille and Audio Reading Download (BARD) service. Ha, who is pursuing a master of fine arts degree at the University of Houston, always has a book checked out from NLS. Recently she was reading Gail Caldwell's Let's Take the Long Way Home in braille. And she is currently working on her “MasterChef” cookbook, which is set for a spring 2013 release.

subItems.title: 21. What kind of dishes won Christine Ha the “MasterChef” title?
subItems.hint:
→ Vietnamese.
（Ha 以哪一國料理贏得 MasterChef 冠軍？→ 越南菜。）
  • 定位：第一段「her three-course meal of Vietnamese comfort food won the 'MasterChef' title.」
  • 其他選項：American（她是美國德州休士頓人）、Houston（地名，非菜系）、Chinese（未提）。
撇步
  • 直接回文找菜名修飾語：Vietnamese comfort food。

subItems.title: 22. Which of the following statements is true?
subItems.hint:
→ Ha's spinal cord was damaged.
（下列何者為真？→ Ha 的脊髓受損。）
  • 定位：第一段「a rare neurological condition that deteriorates the optic nerves and spinal cord」＋「complete paralysis from my neck down due to spinal inflammation」。
  • 其他選項：(A) 是 2003 年才確診，非天生；(B) 2003 年確診，2007 年才幾乎全盲；(D) 2007 年是「失去大部分視力」，不是恢復。
撇步
  • 時間軸：2003 確診 → 2007 幾近全盲；別把順序顛倒。

subItems.title: 23. Which of the following items is NOT available at NLS?
subItems.hint:
→ video games.
（下列何者不是 NLS 提供的？→ 電玩。）
  • 定位：文中列出 NLS 提供：audio and braille books、dozens of magazines、portable playback equipment、線上 BARD 服務。
  • 推論：電玩完全未提及。
  • 其他選項：有聲書、點字雜誌、播放設備都在文中。
撇步
  • 否定題：把文中列出的項目打勾，剩下的就是答案。

subItems.title: 24. According to the passage, which of the following people is NOT eligible for service provided by the NLS?

options.text: A 40-year-old American man who has very low vision.
A 6-year-old American boy living in Taiwan who is blind since birth.
A single mom from Texas whose income is below average.
A young woman from Houston who cannot hold a book because of some injury on her arm.

subItems.hint:
→ A single mom from Texas whose income is below average.
（下列何人不符合 NLS 服務資格？→ 收入偏低的德州單親媽媽。）
  • 定位：NLS 服務對象是「U.S. residents and citizens living abroad who are blind, have low vision, or cannot hold a book because of a physical disability」。
  • 推論：資格取決於視覺或肢體障礙，與收入無關 → 低收入但無障礙者不符資格。
  • 其他選項：(A) 低視力 ✓；(B) 僑居台灣的美國公民且全盲 ✓；(D) 因手臂受傷無法持書 ✓。
撇步
  • 資格題抓三個條件：居民／僑民、盲或低視力或肢體障礙。

subItems.title: 25. According to the passage, which of the following is Christine Ha's status quo?

options.text: She is now a student at the University of Houston.
With improved vision, she is reading books from the university library.
She is in the business of writing cook books for NLS.
A film that is based on her true story is set for a spring 2013 release.

subItems.hint:
→ She is now a student at the University of Houston.
（Ha 目前的狀況是？→ 她現在是休士頓大學的學生。）
  • 定位：第一段「Ha, who is pursuing a master of fine arts degree at the University of Houston...」
  • 其他選項：(B) 視力並未改善，她讀的是 NLS 的點字書；(C) 她寫的是自己的 MasterChef 食譜書，不是為 NLS 寫書；(D) 2013 年春季推出的是食譜書，不是電影。
撇步
  • 細節題注意「spring 2013 release」指的是cookbook，不是 film。
